text:
maria: heads-up: platform wants to introduce `x-rd-route` as canonical and add `x-rd-route-sample`. this will impact client SDK headers + console ingestion. we need a concrete canary + SDK rollout plan.

tom: agreed. can we avoid a hard break? propose SDK-level translation shim that's opt-in initially. devex would ship and support py/ts/go shims.

kevin: for console's dashboards we need stable attribution keys, otherwise quota metrics split. console can merge by a mapping table if we get a clear transition window and a sample field.

maria: transition window suggestion: 1) 2-week dry-run on platform (accept both keys, log mappings) 2) SDKs ship opt-in shim 3) enable-by-default in all SDKs after 10 days 4) 8-week total deprecation for old key. Sound reasonable?

tom: +1. small tweak: make SDK opt-in flag off by default in initial release so early adopters can test. include environment variable toggle for dogfood.

kevin: telemetry ask: please surface route fields in ingestion as separate columns: policy_id (string) and sample_rate (float). console will surface both. also record `route_ambiguous` boolean when both keys seen.

maria: SDK implementation guidelines I propose: - py: add `route` kwarg to client ctor and a boolean `route_shim` arg - ts: add `routeMeta` object + `enableRouteShim` flag - go: functional option `WithRouteMeta(RouteMeta{Policy:"", Sample:0.0})` and `WithRouteShim(true)`. When both headers are present, prefer new key but emit ambiguity metric.

tom: prefer new-over-old too. SDKs should also write a single startup INFO when shim is enabled: "rd.sdk: route shim enabled (x-rd-route-policy -> x-rd-route)" and increment a client-side metric `rd.client.route_shim.enabled`.

kevin: ingestion: ops wants a reconciliation export showing counts by old_key/new_key per hour for the dry-run. that'll help detect split traffic. ops-bot can post daily summaries to #incidents during canary.

devex-bot: Devex Bot: created tracking ticket RD-3862 for SDK shim work. linking: https://internal.redwood/boards/RD-3862

maria: examples to include in SDK READMEs. python example:

```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(route={"policy": "canaryA", "sample": 0.1}, route_shim=True)
```

TS example:

```ts
const c = new RedwoodClient({ routeMeta: { policy: 'canaryA', sample: 0.1 }, enableRouteShim: true });
```

Go example:

```go
c := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithRouteMeta(redwood.RouteMeta{Policy: "canaryA", Sample: 0.1}), redwood.WithRouteShim(true))
```

kevin: quick note on precedence: if both headers exist we will attribute to the new header for quotas but mark `route_ambiguous` so SREs can backfill if needed. also add a daily aggregated report for first 2 weeks after flip.

maria: action owners: platform -> post contract doc + dry-run toggle (maria). devex -> PR drafts for py/ts/go shims (tom). console -> ingestion mapping + ambiguity report (kevin). ops -> daily dry-run report to #incidents (ops-bot). I'll draft a short migration doc for customers.

tom: I'll open py/ts/go PRs this week with feature flags and tests. will include E2E test that simulates old->new header translation and ambiguity metric emission.

kevin: I'll coordinate with telemetry infra to add `policy_id`, `sample_rate`, `route_ambiguous` fields in ingestion schema. will also add a dashboard mapping stub.

maria: one last UX ask: console should keep a small banner in the Policy dashboard during the canary noting the header rename and expected date for full switch to `x-rd-route`. any objections?

kevin: no objections. banner helps surface to customers.

maria: great. track blockers here. will update after contract PR is merged.

ops-bot: Ops Bot: dry-run enabled in staging at 2024-08-15T09:00Z. will post hourly reconciles.

maria: thanks everyone, closing task list for now. reopen if blockers appear. :rocket:
